# Set Low Power Mode

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the devices low power mode.

## Syntax

~~~~text
lowPowerMode(state: <#BoolNumb#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
lowPowerMode(state: false)
~~~~
